# Upstream (Kit & Alex's) recipes this deployment deliberately does not host.
#
# The Scala captures in `capture-scala/` are the full upstream corpus, but a
# deployment is a product of its own: it hosts a subset of upstream plus its
# own (chaos-tagged) recipes. `every_hosted_recipe_equals_its_capture_byte_for_byte`
# requires that every capture is either a recipe we host or one of these, so
# dropping an upstream recipe is a deliberate edit here rather than a silent
# loss - and this list cannot go stale. One `object_name` per line.
